a: Latency, traffic, errors, and saturation are classic golden signals.
Show SLI, SLO target, and error budget burn.
Do not put unbounded user ids as metric labels.
Alert on user-visible symptoms more than internal causes alone.
Every page should link to a runbook.
Version dashboard JSON/Terraform like application code.
Link slow metrics to example traces.
Distinguish no-data from zero values on charts.
Use clear titles, units, and thresholds for stressed humans.
